source_title: Micron Technology Fiscal Q3 2024 Earnings Call Prepared Remarks
claim_relevant_visible_text: Industrywide, HBM3E consumes approximately three times the wafer supply as D5 to produce a given number of bits in the same technology node.
researcher_paraphrase: Micron quantified HBM3E's silicon/wafer trade ratio at about 3x D5 for equal bits on the same node, supporting a front-end capacity mechanism and a displacement effect on non-HBM DRAM supply.
precision_guard: The 3x figure is Micron's industrywide estimate for HBM3E versus D5 bits on the same node. It does not prove front-end wafer supply was the sole or immediate HBM delivery bottleneck, and it must not be applied unchanged to HBM4 or all suppliers without separate support.
authority_boundary: Micron is primary for its own prepared remarks and methodological claim about HBM silicon intensity; it is not an independent audit of every supplier's realized trade ratio.
